content: Bank Indonesia official QRIS page states MPM static QR lacks transaction amount, customers enter amount manually, and users/merchants receive notifications. Direct open failed but official indexed page content was available and matching sections cross-checked. Lafu inference: show group total and recipient, compare claimed proof against actual incoming transaction, and keep uploaded evidence separate from admin-confirmed payment. https://www.bi.go.id/id/fungsi-utama/sistem-pembayaran/ritel/kanal-layanan/qris/default.aspx
